questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Service Architecture”?
options: Service Architecture helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
Service Architecture means the browser can enforce all permissions without the backend.
Service Architecture removes the need for error handling, accessibility checks and tests.
Service Architecture should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
questions.answer_key: Service Architecture helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: Service Architecture is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.prompt: How should a learner work with “Data services” in this lesson?
options: Treat “Data services” as a reason to skip the surrounding application context.
Assume “Data services” works identically across every Angular major and runtime.
Use “Data services” to bypass runtime validation of external or user-provided values.
Connect “Data services” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.answer_key: Connect “Data services” to the lesson goal, use a focused example, and validate the behavior in the selected Angular environment.
questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “Data services” under Service Architecture. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “Service Architecture”?
options: Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
questions.answer_key: Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.
questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
